(315)༄༅/ /ri chos bai ḍūrya'i phreng ba zhes bya ba thar 'dod kyi mgul rgyan bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (315)༄༅// ri chos bai ḍūrya'i phreng ba zhes bya ba thar 'dod kyi mgul rgyan bzhugs so/// /

(316)༄༅// na ma shrī gu ra we/ rnam dag bde ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// shes bya'i gnas snang gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis// 'gro la phan bde'i phun tshogs stsol ba'i lha// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ma dag 'khor ba las kyi dkyil 'khor du// mi bzad rnam smin du ma'i 'bras bu can// yang yang duḥkha'i btson rar nyam thag pa// nged cag srid 'gro'i las can 'di la gzigs// 'khrul 'khor du mas thog med dus nas mnar// skyid 'dod chung ngus srid pa'i las chen bsags// rang rgyags dregs pa'i snang ba dgrar 'bod pa'i// da dung 'khor ba'i las la bcos med kyang*// rgyal kun thugs rjes gzigs pa'i mdo rgyud dang*// 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi bka' lung dang*// grub thob brgyud pa'i rnam thar bzang po ltar// thar 'dod 'ga' la gces pa'i gdams ngag bshad// rang yang snying nas tshe 'di spang dka' bas// da dus skye bo mi srun kho na la// gnad nas bskul te phan par sbyor skad pa// phal cher khong khro 'khrugs pa'i rgyu ru bas// 'on kyang rna bar gang snyan dam chos min// 'phral snang gang (317)dga' phan pa yin nges med// slob ma brid pa'ang thugs rje ma yin pas// dpang por sangs rgyas 'jog phyir nongs 'gyod med// brtags bzhin 'khrul med gyur na dam chos yin// sgrub bzhin 'gyod med bde na thar lam yin// slob ma lam la sbyor na bla ma yin// gsung de chos su go na slob ma yin// chen po'i ming gis bslus pa'i bla ma dal// de bsten khe grags sgrub 'dod slob ma dang*// ltar snang gzhan mgo 'khor ba'i dam chos can// da dus bdag 'dra'i bla mar ma gyur cig /khyod cag ngan 'gro'i gnas nas mi lus rnyed// skye 'gro las ngan nar nas bstan la zhugs// yang srid btson rar chud kha thar 'dod na// dge ba bskul phyir gong ma'i bka' stsal gdams// dang po sems la lcag 'debs rnam pa bcu// 'khor ba'i bde 'byor sdug bsngal btson rar yin/

1 /nor gyi gsog 'jog dgra 'dre'i ngo len yin/ 2 /khyim gyi gza' dpon spyi sdug sger khur yin/ 3 /dpon gyi ngo 'dzin mi don rang phung yin/ 4 /bla sde'i 'khor g.yog 'di phyi stong zad yin// nye ba'i ngo srung sha mkhon 'khor med yin// 'bad pa'i bde (318)'dod sdug gi bsnon ma yin/ 7 /g.yo sgyu che 'dod rang phung mgo skor yin/ 8 /tshe 'di'i kha dngos dga'i slu tshig yin/ 9 /chos min mtha' dag bdud kyi bslu ba yin/ 10 /de las byol ba'i bya ba btang tshul bcu// tshe 'di skyid kyang thongs na gtan skyid 'grub/ 1 /gnyen zlas brid kyang thar na bya ba thengs/ 2 /yul mkhar legs kyang bor na rtsol sgrub chung*/ 3 /so nam 'grub kyang bzhag na sems las med/ 4 /nye bas phan kyang thar na re 'khong zad/ 5 /mang pos bkur yang bros na khag khur chung*/ 6 /gzhan dbang chud kyang byol na nyes 'gyod med/ 7 /che khur thob kyang spangs na rtsi bgrangs nyung*/ 8 /mdza' bshes mthun yang spangs na ngo srung sla/ 9 /za chog 'brim yang bzhag na zag pa chung*/ 10 /de la dgos pa'i cha rkyen rnam pa bcu// mgon dpon dor nas mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ 1 /yul mkhar bskyur nas nyams dga'i dben gnas bzung*/ 2 /nor rdzas bor nas snyan brgyud gdams ngag 'chang*/ 3 /'brel grogs spangs nas rang nyid gcig pur 'dug 4 /che thabs bor nas dman pa'i cha lugs bzung*/ 5 /mthun 'jug bor nas rang thag rang gis gcod/ 6 /gsog 'jog bshol nas 'phral gyi gang byung byed/ 7 /bde 'dod bor nas chos phyir dka' thub spyad/ 8 /'khor g.yog bor nas 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas byed/ 9 /snang shas bor nas tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub/ 10 /de la log pa'i blo ldog rnam pa bcu// bya ba btang dus tshe 'dis rtsis bgrang skyur/ 1 /bla ma rnyed dus 'phral gyi bde ma brtsi/ 2 /gdams ngag zhu dus bcong zog kha chos spongs/ 3 /dam chos sgrub dus mi kha'i dogs ma rtsi/

4 /lto rgyab zhan dus grong pa'i glud ma bsdu/ 5 /'tsho ba'i lhag mas bun skyed khe ma dran/ 6 /chas (319)gos mchod spyad snang shas 'phyong ma bkyags/ 7 /las ngan slong dus sdug bsngal ro ma myongs/ 8 /smin dka' tshol dus 'phral bde'i smon ma 'debs/ 9 /bde skyid byung dus dge sbyor sbur ma shor/ 10 /rgyun du bslab bya'i spyod lam rnam bcu ni// bsod snyoms btsal dus so thar sbyongs yon bzung*/ 1 /sgrub la dril tshe sngags kyi smin grol bsgom/ 2 /dus rnam kun tu byang sems bslab bya sbyang*/ 3 /ri mtshams smra bcad sems dben khor yug bya/ 4 /mthun 'jug ngos dga' spyi ser rtsis gdab phral/ 5 /dam pa rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal med bya/ 6 /mthun rkyen mi la'ang chos mthun thabs kyis bskyang*/ 7 /lo bas ring ba'i cha rkyen spang dag bya/ 8 /gcig pur 'dug dus mnyam gzhag rjes thob bsre/ 9 /mang po'i gseb tu yengs med bya ra bsgrim/ 10 /sgrub pa'i nyams len gcig dril rnam bcu ni// thun gyi dang po skyo shas nges 'byung bskyed/ 1 /skyabs sems dus su phan sems brtse gdung bsgom/ 2 /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyongs 'bad rtsol sems las khur/ 3 /mos gus brjed med khong yus gdung shugs bskyed/ 4 /bskyed rim bzlas brjod stong nyid rol pas khyer/ 5 /nyin snang thams cad sgyu ma'i rgya yis gdab/ 6 /mtshan snang gnyid dang 'od gsal 'dres par bzung*/ 7 /chos spyod gtor ma nyams kyi tshod ltar bya/ 8 /bsngo ba rang sems 'gro ba bsre la gdab/ 9 /thams cad kun slong dge ba'i spyod pas bskyang*/ 10 /de nas rtse gcig mnyam gzhag skyong tshul bcu// bsgom rgyu mi rnyed ma bsam gang shar tshol/ 1 /shar ba'i rang ngo ltos la de gar shig 2 /dran tshe 'gyu ba ma bkag rang 'gros skyongs/ 3 /ma dran dmigs pas gcun la gnas sna srings/ 4 /rang grol sprul mdud 'dra dus 'gyu sna khrid// stong gsal nam (320)mkha' 'dra dus yul dang bsres/

6 /sems kyi dwangs snyigs sbyangs dus dbyings su skyur/ 7 /dran tsam blo bral rtogs dus nyin snang sbyongs/ 8 /snang bzang thal shar dus mtshan snang sbyongs/ 9 /rig pa gcer bur thon dus snying rje sgoms/ 10 /med du mi rung thabs kyi bsgrub bya bcu// stong nyid mkha' ltar rtogs kyang skyabs sems sbyongs/ 1 /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres kyang mos gus sgoms/ 2 /snang srid chos skur rtogs kyang ri khrod zungs/ 3 /gnyis snang 'khrul pa dag kyang phan sems sbyongs/ 4 /rnam smin bag chags zad kyang las 'bras rtsis/ 5 /sems nyid chos skur rtogs kyang thun mtshams sbrel/ 6 /mnyam gzhag rjes thob dag kyang dge sbyor 'bad/ 7 /mchog dang thun mong 'grub kyang rlom sems spongs/ 8 /'gro kun smin cing grol yang ngas byas skyur/ 9 /skye rgu'i gtsug tu khur yang che khur zhog 10 /med kyang gang byas chog pa'i lam khyer bcu// 'khrul na gnyen por ma bsten rang ngo ltos/ 1 /na na gces 'dzin ma byed 'dre la byin/ 2 /bgegs la 'dre brdung ma byed snying rje sgoms/ 3 /dgra la khe drags ma rtse bdag 'dzin thul/ 4 /gnyen la gdung sems ma bskyed kha 'dzin dor// grogs la mthun 'thug ma rtsi gcig pur sdod/ 6 /rang rgyal pho tshugs ma 'dzin rnam thar skyongs/ 7 /chos kyi tha snyad ma bgrang de nyid tshol/ 8 /ltad mo yul la ma blta sems la ltos/ 9 /'gro la phyogs ris ma byed smon lam thob/ 10 /de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu phan pa bcu// rnam thar bzang pos rgyal ba'i bstan la phan/ 1 /smon lam snying rjes ma gyur 'gro la phan/ 2 /nye mkhon med pas sdang ba'i dgra la phan/ 3 /re mkhon med pas ltos pa'i gnyen la phan/ 4 /sos dal spyod lam bde bas lus la phan/ 5 /nyams rtogs yon (321)tan 'phel bas sems la phan/ 6 /bar chad sdug bsngal chung bas tshe 'dir phan/ 7 /goms 'dris brtan pa thob pas bar dor phan/ 8 /bslu med lam sna zin pas phyi mar phan/

9 /nges par mngon sangs rgya bas mthar thug phan/ 10 /de ltar bsgrubs na yid ches bde ba brgyad// drin can bla ma rnams kyis bu bzhin skyong*/ 1 /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin ltar 'du/ 2 /phyi rgyud snang srid lha 'dres sdong grogs byed/ 3 /che btsun mkhas grub rnams kyis bsngags par mdzad/ 4 /sdang ba'i dgras smon byams pa'i gnyen yang dang*/ 5 /dman pas skyabs zhu dregs ldan chen pos btud/ 6 /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pas gnas skabs skyid/ 7 /'jigs pa kun las grol bas mthar thug bde/ 8 /de ltar lcag 'debs bcu 10dang gtong tshul bcu/10 /sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bcu 10dang blo ldog bcu10// thabs kyi spyod lam bcu 10dang gcig dril bcu/10 /sems kyi bzhag thabs bcu 10dang bsgrub bya bcu/10 /zlog sgom lam khyer bcu 10dang phan pa bcu/10 /yid ches sems kyi gding tshad bde ba brgyad/8 /ngo mtshar baiḍū'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad// chos byed thar 'dod mgul pa'i mdzes rgyan yin// tshul 'di don med nyams mtshar kho na'i phyir/ kha bshad mang du 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis// dge slong kun dga' la sogs bskul mkhan 'ga'i// don gnyer rnams la thun mong chos sbyin byed/ kha bshad khram pa'i shags dang mtshar gtam rnams// la la dga' yang la la sdug pa'i phyir// gzhan la mi phan zag pa 'phel ba'i rgyu// de phyir da ni mi smra zhe bcad byed// sngon rabs rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi// thabs rnams du mas 'gro ba 'dul ba dang*// bya dang shing dang 'od dang mkha' las kyang*// chos sgras 'gro (322)la phan bder 'gyur bar smon// bdag la chos kyis 'brel ba'i 'gro ba kun// g.yo sgyu zol zog che 'dod kun spangs nas// mthong thos dran reg bde la 'god pa yi// bka' brgyud gong ma'i dgongs pa skong byed shog /mi lus thob kyang blo bde'i don go med// rtsol sgrub bzhag kyang dkor gyi rnam smin khur// dam chos bshad kyang gzhan phan mthu chung bas// rang gzhan su yang thar pa'i 'jug ngogs bral// snyigs dus sdug bsngal las kyi bsu skyel mkhan// bdag 'dra'i bla gzugs thob pa dga' ma tshor// bdag cag nam zhig 'chi 'phos gyur ma thag

/mi srun gdug pa'i phyogs 'dir mi skye zhing*// 'dod gzugs mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan gyis// theg chen chos kyis skal ldan smin par shog /las kyis skyes kyang rgya gar 'phags yul sogs// o rgyan sprul pa'i dpa' bo ḍā ki'i rigs// gsang sngags spyod pa'i lus su skyes nas kyang*// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang chen 'grub gyur cig /grub nas rnal 'byor grub chen brgyad po ltar// dngos med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob ste// dmigs med snying rjes 'gro ba ma lus pa// rang gzhan zag med dbyings su 'god par shog /karma pa sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam chos skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i stobs// bdag gi rnam dkar dge rtsa ci yod mthus// smon lam btab bzhin gegs med 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ ma spros mnyam pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// byang chub grub pa'i khyab bdag dang po'i 'od// gsang ba'i rig pa'i thabs brgyar shar ba las// ri chos gdams pa'i dwang ma 'di yang rmad// de phyir byang chub (323)phyogs kyi chos 'phel nas// 'dzad med spar gyi ring bsrel bskrun pa'i dges// bder gshegs rigs kyis khyab pa'i mkha' mnyam 'gro// dri med rgyal ba'i rang zhal mngon gyur shog /ces drung rin po che kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi ri chos 'di nyid spar du bsgrubs skabs spar byang smon tshig 'di 'bru dag byed po zur ban padma rnam rgyal gyis smras pa'o/// /(324)
